title: Does recent volatility (ATR%) predict pick outcome, independent of accumulation/relative-strength?

tables.name: Win rate/avg return by volatility quartile (MAX_HOLD_DAYS=3)

notes: Q1 = lowest volatility, Q4 = highest. Computed independently of accumulation_signal (volume-vs-price-move) -- this measures price range/swing size (ATR% over the trailing 10 trading days), a genuinely different axis.

conclusion.summary: Led to VOLATILITY_MAX_ATR_PCT going live in predictor.py (2026-07-29) -- high-volatility candidates get excluded. See volatility_filter_substitution_check.py for the real substitution test that confirmed it.
